route.displayName: H2O Wireless Pay As You Go US number
route.form: prepaid SIM/eSIM options must be rechecked at purchase

kyc.label: Identity requirement not yet verified
kyc.note: The official terms reviewed so far do not give the MVP enough evidence to state a universal passport/ID requirement.

roamingSms.label: Do not assume Pay As You Go can roam internationally
roamingSms.note: H2O's current terms say International Roaming requires an active Unlimited Talk and Text plan with roaming balance. That does not establish international roaming for this Pay As You Go route.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling abroad not verified
wifiCallingAbroad.note: No current official evidence has been added to this MVP establishing overseas Wi-Fi SMS/OTP behavior for H2O Pay As You Go.

setup.note: Broadband Facts lists $0 one-time fee for the $10 PayGo plan.

tax.note: Government taxes vary; federal and administrative/regulatory fees are also listed.

shipping.note: SIM/eSIM fulfillment is not included in this refill-only model.

promotion.note: Official page shows a 10% AutoPay discount, but cost windows use the undiscounted list refill.

30.note: Minimum documented $10 refill covers up to 90 days before usage; excludes taxes/fees.

90.note: One $10 refill; recharge before expiry if retaining the number.

365.note: Five $10/90-day refills span at least 365 days if using this minimum refill route; usage can reduce balance sooner.

refundClarity.note: Official terms say refills have no cash redemption value and are nonrefundable, including after cancellation.

stockEvidence.note: SIM/eSIM stock is not guaranteed by this dataset.

numberControl.note: $0 balance for 30 consecutive days cancels the account and number.

independentReview.note: No independent review snapshot is used in this MVP record.

fairPriceCheck.label: Official price baseline
fairPriceCheck.note: This route uses the provider’s own published price as the benchmark. A third-party quote above this baseline may be a markup; this does not prove the official route is the cheapest possible alternative.

data.caveat: Cheap PAYG retention, but current overseas SMS continuity is not a strong point.

data.summary: Initial activation and overseas SMS/roaming behavior are not yet sufficiently verified for an overseas-user recommendation.
data.outsideHomeNote: If you are outside the US, this route remains research-required rather than recommended.

data.inactivity_window: The current $10 and $30 Pay As You Go refills expire after 90 days; the $100 refill expires after 365 days. If account balance remains $0 for 30 consecutive days, the account and phone number are cancelled.
data.clock_start_or_reset: The refill expiration clock starts from the purchased refill/renewal. Recharging before expiration preserves eligibility; the official page says remaining balance rolls over when the same amount is recharged before expiration.
qualifying_activity: Recharge the Pay As You Go plan before its stated expiration date.
Use AutoPay where offered to renew the selected refill before expiry.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts and data consume balance but are not documented as extending the refill expiration date.
Account login or incoming service does not replace the refill requirement.
Do not treat the 30-day $0-balance period as a normal retention strategy.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Renew the $10 / 90-day Pay As You Go refill. The current official plan page shows $9 with AutoPay.
data.safest_documented_action: Recharge the same Pay As You Go amount before its expiration date and verify the balance/plan renewed; keep the account away from a $0 balance.

minimum_expected_cost.basis: current $10 PayGo refill with advertised 10% AutoPay discount
minimum_expected_cost.note: Without AutoPay, the documented refill is $10; taxes/fees may apply.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the selected refill expiration date.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: If the balance is $0, cancellation occurs after 30 consecutive days at $0. Restore funded service before that point.
data.termination_and_recycling: After 30 consecutive days at $0, H2O says the account and phone number are cancelled. The cited terms do not state the exact number-recycling timetable.

reminder.anchor_help: Enter the expiration date shown for your current PayGo refill. Current $10/$30 refills are 90 days and the $100 refill is 365 days, so using the actual expiration date avoids assuming the wrong refill cycle.
reminder.summary: Recharge H2O PayGo before refill expiry
reminder.description: Recharge before the current refill expires and keep the account away from a $0 balance. The calendar event is placed 7 days before the expiration date you enter.
